title: SAST, DAST, SCA in CI/CD Pipelines

scenes.line1: How do you automate finding bugs?
scenes.say: Ever wondered how to catch security issues before your app hits production? What’s your approach for automating this in your pipeline?
A solid pipeline runs static code scans, checks your dependencies for risks, and tests your app while it’s live. Each step catches different types of vulnerabilities.
Static analysis checks your code without running it. Dynamic testing probes your live app, simulating real attacks. Both together give broad coverage.

scenes.title: Security Tools in Action
scenes.say: In practice, your pipeline might run Snyk to scan dependencies, SonarQube for code analysis, and OWASP ZAP to test the app while it’s running.

scenes.question: What if DAST finds a flaw?
scenes.right: Block deployment until the flaw is fixed and retested.
scenes.say: If dynamic testing finds a flaw, don’t just push to production. Block the deployment until you fix and verify the issue.
